attempted_claim: Let F be a totally real field of degree d with p>=5 unramified in F, and K/F a CM quadratic extension in which every v|p splits and satisfying condition (4) of Wan (Forum Math. Sigma 3 (2015), e18). Let f be a cohomological cuspidal Hilbert eigenform over F of parallel weight kappa0>=2, trivial character, tame level M prime to p, equipped with a non-critically refined finite-slope p-stabilisation, Iwahori-spherical at v|p in the sense of Barrera-Dimitrov-Williams. Assume the residual hypotheses (irred_K) and a finite-slope analogue of (dist) for the chosen refinement, and the prime-to-p level shape M=M+ M- of Wan Theorem 3. Let K_infty=K_infty^+ K_infty^- with Gamma_K isomorphic to Z_p^{d+1}, let L_{f,K}^Sigma be the Sigma-imprimitive finite-slope p-adic L-function varying over the Hilbert eigenvariety, and let X_{K_infty}^Sigma(f) be the corresponding finite-slope (Greenberg-Pottharst trianguline) dual Selmer group. Prove, by eigenvariety interpolation and Klingen Eisenstein congruences on U(2,2), the fixed-weight one-sided divisibility char_{K_infty}^Sigma(f) subseteq (L_{f,K}^Sigma) in O_L[[Gamma_K]] tensor Q_p, with integral refinement in O_L[[Gamma_K]] conditional on the finite-slope Hecke Gorenstein property, without assuming f is nearly ordinary.
